rounds.recommendations: When writing boundary checks in GPU kernels, avoid redundant guards that are mathematically guaranteed by the launch configuration. If a variable is computed via modulo (e.g., `ow = idx % width`), then checking `ow >= width` is always dead code. Mutation testing on such redundant guards will always produce unkillable mutants, which wastes analysis effort. Consider static analysis tools that can detect and flag unreachable predicates in CUDA kernels.
